findings.summary: Dev-note input_commit does not match this attempt's dispatch input_commit. Spec §5 item 4 requires the dev-note input_commit to be the dispatch's input_commit (25f17ef0f6b577638fdbd287eecc71d34d34ed34 for this rework attempt), but docs/dev-notes/dev_ledr_g5_triage_read_01.md:4 records c33bb08043e0e3ee52317807a3cbd4ff611e4cdd. This breaks the audit-trail identity discipline but does not affect product code correctness; the same minor class was noted (and tolerated under APPROVE) in attempts 1 and 2.
